column1: # Real pages captured from both sites, unedited.
# capture_url is where the bytes came from; app_url is the URL the app itself uses.
# They differ on exactly three rows: novelfull.com's catalogue does not carry
# those short novels (they 404 there), so those came from novelfull.net, which
# serves the same application. Everything else is the real .com/.today page,
# fetched through the dev Worker (see tools/README.md).
# chapters_in_container and max_page were measured at capture time by a separate
# script, NOT by this app's parser, so the tests cross-check rather than echo.
